title: The person's integration catalog and connected accounts, read live from each tool

provider_id.description: apple is the Apple (iCloud) tile: its services are ordinary imap, caldav and carddav accounts, which carry apple_id.

skill.description: The generated personal-data skill: current, none (no accounts), blocked (a file the host did not write occupies its path) or failed (could not be written).

available.description: False when the tool is not installed or the operator has not configured the application.

unavailable_reason.description: Present only when unavailable: app_credentials_required when the tools are installed and only the operator's application registration is missing, tool_unavailable otherwise.

missing_tools.description: With tool_unavailable only: the catalog's tools this installation does not provide as trusted executables, in the entry's order.

failure.description: Why a sync_failed service stopped or why a sync_restarting service's latest pass failed; the native login is retained. quota_insufficient and quota_unavailable are a transient initial-inventory admission refusal; initial_sync_incomplete is a working login whose first sync never finished and is not being resumed (signing in again offers the initial choice); initial_sync_resume_failed is a first sync that a daemon stop interrupted, whose automatic resume then failed. needs_resync is a critical abort only an explicit resync recovers: on sync_failed the native listings were set aside (signing in again is not the remedy), on sync_restarting the latest pass said so. Also on sync_restarting: delete_limit is bisync's mass-deletion safeguard, remote_unreachable a pass that could not reach the provider and pass_failed any other failed pass. A pass failure stays until a pass succeeds. On login_expired, every service of an account whose native configuration could not follow the operator's current application carries the reason: app_changed when it was signed in with another application, tenant_changed when the application's tenant refused its grant (signing in again is the remedy for both), outside_tenant when the account is not in that tenant's directory (signing in again cannot help).

last_synced_at.description: When the latest successful sync pass ended, from the tool's own committed listings; for several libraries, the oldest. Absent before the first pass has finished.

sync_progress.description: Transient native rclone current-pass stats: the initial pass on a syncing service, an ordinary pass running now on an ok or sync_restarting one. Totals may change while listing and reset between Microsoft libraries. No messages or filenames.

apple_id.description: Present when the account's stored server is Apple's iCloud: the Apple ID whose card shows it. A mail account's address is its iCloud Mail address, which may differ.
